description: MORR whole-watershed-group outlet — Morice River mainstem at the Bulkley (Wedzin Kwa) confluence. Single break point => one sub-basin covering the entire MORR group (verified 4382.2 km2 vs 4379.1 km2 group area; captures 4877/4877 coho order-3+ segments). Interior sub-basin delineation deferred to a later pass (issue #1 Phase 3).
